American telecommunications company headquartered in New York City. The company was founded as Bell Atlantic Corporation and renamed to Verizon on June 30, 2000 as a result of a merger with GTE.
Bell Atlantic was originally headquartered in Philadelphia and operated in the states of Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, and West Virginia.

AT&T is the world's third-largest telecommunications company by revenue, the third-largest wireless carrier in the United States behind T-Mobile and Verizon, and the nation's largest fiber internet provider.
about.summary_cs: Americká telekomunikační společnost sídlící v texaském Dallasu. Je druhým největším dodavatelem mobilních telefonů a největším dodavatelem pevných linek v USA. Poskytuje také širokopásmové předplacení televizních služeb.
